description: This file defines the 'LoanProductGuaranteeData' class, which is a data transfer object (DTO) for representing guarantee-related data associated with a loan product within the Fineract project. It includes fields for guarantee amounts, product ID, and static factory methods for creating instances with specific or default values.

classes.name: LoanProductGuaranteeData
classes.description: A final, serializable data class that holds guarantee-related information for a loan product, including guarantee amounts and identifiers. It provides static factory methods for creating instances with provided data or default values.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static factory method for creating a 'LoanProductGuaranteeData' instance with specified guarantee data and identifiers.

methods.name: sensibleDefaultsForNewLoanProductCreation
methods.description: Static factory method returning a 'LoanProductGuaranteeData' instance with all fields set to null, representing default values for new loan product creation.
